name: Bebe
source:
Senior

- Great-granddaughter of school's founder
- [b]Obsessed with dolls[/b]
- [b]Has underclassmen she calls her dolls[/b]
- [b]More than willing to spoil dolls[/b]

- [b]Would love to have one more perfect doll[/b]
